description: Defines a Flutter widget for the login screen in a mobile banking app. It includes UI components for email and display name input, and handles user login logic including navigation post-authentication.

classes.name: LoginScreen
classes.description: A Flutter stateful widget that renders a login form with email and optional display name input fields.

classes.name: _LoginScreenState
classes.description: State class for LoginScreen that manages user input, loading state, and login submission logic.

methods.name: dispose
methods.description: Disposes of the text editing controllers when the widget is removed from the widget tree.

methods.name: _submit
methods.description: Handles form submission: validates input, performs login via AuthProvider, and navigates based on authentication state.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree for the login screen, including input fields, buttons, and informational text.
